answer: Build a trellis of earned trust: each agent starts as a single grain on a vast dune, able to trade only tiny amounts. To grow, it must complete verifiable work that established peers attest, each attestation a new rung on the trellis. A Sybil attacker faces a nebula of disconnected fake identities, each stuck at the dune's base with no attestation history, because trust cannot be minted, only grown through witnessed work over time.
